The [[Lake of Fire]] is an area of [[the Fissure of Woe]] located in the south-eastern corner. The area is typified by large lava pools flowing from a giant volcano at the edge of the area. There is only one exit from the lake, which leads back towards the [[Tower of Strength (landmark)|Tower of Strength]] or the [[Temple of War]].

The Lake of Fire is inhabited by [[Obsidian Furnace Drake]]s, [[Smoke Walker]]s and a few [[Infernal Wurm]]s. [[Khobay the Betrayer]] fled here after his betrayal of the other Eternals inside the Temple of War.
